proof: seenMap is a Set<Path>; Set.keys yields only stored Path values. The mapper returns an existing fileName or the same Path, both strings; the generator filters undefined results.
getKeys returns a ReadonlySet<Path>; its keys iterator yields only stored Path values. Completion is not a yielded value.

The typeof-object guard narrows type to Map<string, string | number>. entries yields stored key/value tuples; iterator completion is not an array element, so both destructuring callbacks receive a tuple.

countLines returns Map<string, number>. values yields stored numbers only; reduceLeftIterator initializes its accumulator to 0 and only replaces it with a numeric sum. Completion is not a callback value.
